name: Chaldean Catholic Church

facts.value: soon after 1551, when Sulaqa was consecrated Patriarch of the Chaldeans at Rome. Lasting union in 1830

citations.excerpt: they sent him to Rome , where he received episcopal consecration from Julius III , with the title of Patriarch of the Chaldeans.
John Hormizd had been excommunicated in 1818, but was reconciled with Rome in 1830 and proclaimed Patriarch of Babylon by Pius VIII
In 1551 the Catholicos Simeon bar Mama was succeeded by his nephew, Simeon Denha.
The name of former Nestorians now reunited with the Roman Church .

facts.value: Former Nestorians reunited with the Roman Church, found mostly in Kirkuk, Arbil and Mosul.

citations.excerpt: most of the Chaldean population being found in the cities of Kerkuk , Arbil, and Mosul, in the heart of the Tigris valley

facts.value_before_verify: Catholics of the East Syriac tradition, mainly in northern Iraq, including Kirkuk, Arbil and Mosul.
